notes:
## New features

- Double-click a building, area source, line source or barrier to edit its nodes. Shift-click selects additional nodes for moving together. Hold Option/Alt over an edge to insert a node on that edge, or over a node to remove it. Delete/Backspace also removes selected nodes. Minimum valid node counts are enforced.
- Editing handles remain visible and selectable above overlapping objects.
- Building height is now near the top of the inspector. Building names and one-decimal height labels can be displayed independently.
- With a point source/receptor selected, or during placement, hold Control/Command to anchor a live distance guide at the cursor.

## Changes

- Receptor placement uses Shift for a 1 m façade offset and Shift+Option/Alt for placement on the façade.

## Bug fixes

- Smooth projected-node previews, clearer hover handles and immediate façade previews when modifier keys change.
- Reuse receiver workers across reconstruction passes, avoiding repeated process startup and teardown without changing acoustic settings or refinement tolerances.

- Reduced progress-update overhead in projects with large saved calculation histories and embedded logos. Acoustic calculation accuracy and refinement settings are unchanged.
- Focused editor, persistence, save/update and native interaction checks were used for this hotfix. This is not a new full-suite or ISO conformance claim.
- Contour reconstruction support can still take longer than expected, including in small scenes. This release does not claim that total Calculate performance is resolved.
- macOS application is ad-hoc signed, not Apple notarized.
